label: Health check: how much is enough

params.name: min_free_gb
params.label: Warn when the data disk has less free space than this (GB)

params.name: cert_min_days
params.label: Warn when the site's certificate ends in fewer days than this

params.name: timeout_s
params.label: Give each outside check this many seconds

params.name: work_hours
params.label: An agent whose latest run in this many hours failed or was cut short shows on the warning bar

params.name: probe_file
params.label: File written and removed in the data folder to prove it takes a write

params.name: db_probe
params.label: Query each Postgres database must answer

params.name: reason_chars
params.label: Longest reason shown when a probe fails (characters)

params.name: alert_states
params.label: Agent run states (agents.settings run_states keys) that put an agent on the warning bar

params.name: drill_max_days
params.label: Warn when the last good restore drill is older than this many days

params.name: drill_record
params.label: Data-folder file (no .json) where tools/restore_drill.py writes its last result

params.name: drill_smoke_path
params.label: Address the restored copy must answer 200 on (the api smoke)

params.name: drill_smoke_timeout_s
params.label: Seconds the restored copy's api smoke may take

params.name: drill_backup_glob
params.label: Which files in the backups folder are backups (the newest is drilled)

params.name: stale_hours
params.label: The warning bar's answer is older than this many hours (the daily check stopped): owners are told the bar may be out of date
